modification_description: Make the urgent/non-urgent branch more concrete and tighten timing: (1) immediate 30-60s pause with 'are you safe?' check; (2) if potentially dangerous (self-harm, severe panic, medical risk), call for emergency support and exit promptly after brief teammate notification; (3) if serious but not dangerous, respond fully for a bounded 5-10 minute window or complete only a very short clearly-defined segment (not an indeterminate phase), then commit to uninterrupted support rather than repeated back-and-forth; (4) always provide explicit commitment that roommate won't be left alone plus an estimated support plan — reduces risk that 'complete current segment' becomes unacceptably long and makes the roommate feel abandoned.
